objective: Consolidated BUKLOD MAIN Genesis 2.0.5 staging OTA JS-only source candidate: truthful call receipt/ringback/outcome and Wall post owner edit/privacy/delete, without overwriting signed Godot native source.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production GitHub main 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f. Latest verified 2.0.4 published Android OTA group 7411bd8d-5c80-47c5-b120-e52570768ce5 from SHA 63f97c4092c1214c8f0b0eb5558d1183c6f189d4. Original-signed 2.0.5 APK from SHA 435e071da41c83071f545c9b209acb562863f7d2, GitHub run 45116010037 and artifact 14794360606, CI signed/native proof passed. Next parent f63018b15613908f70d21580d63fa4f2afe3c8e2 only changes read-only receipt workflow. No physical Godot launch or AdMob phone verification.
chosenApproach: Inherit installed 2.0.4 OTA JS source plus signed 2.0.5 native fixes, apply owner E2E post changes from main PR 1138 through exact strict patch hunks (without overwriting Genesis-only regions), then port call PR 1140 with exact existing Stream/Ringing components and remove the duplicate direct-thread rejection handler. Other unverified items remain explicit release holds.
selectionRationale: Reconcile only code with non-conflicting proven hunk matches; preserve original-signed app/native runtime and 2.0.4/production EAS separation. Direct full-branch merges would include incompatible native, conflicting Wall variants and undeployed backend migrations.
alternativeApproaches: Publish mixed 2.0.4 JS code against 2.0.5 native runtime (rejected because runtimeVersion must match).
Merge all DEV branches and backend SQL immediately (rejected because conflict and live shared Supabase/RLS risks).
Force untested Android Godot or recipient push support as verified (rejected because source-only and signed-binary proofs are not device tests).
preserveBehaviors: Original signer, staging package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging, Android versionCode17, native runtime 2.0.5-genesis-godot-launch and EAS channel season2-genesis-library-205-preview unchanged.
Never alter app.config.js, eas.json, package-lock.json, Godot, plugins, modules, bundled native Arena audio/assets or Supabase for OTA.
Existing AdMob consent/first-view/fill, instant Home/Wall/Connect navigation, signed media URLs, privacy, PTT and dark mode remain protected.
Incoming call ringtone/FCM and call push are native owned; a server ring alone never claims delivery/recipient audible ringing.
Privacy and delete require existing server authorization, no media loss, and stable scroll positions; caller status and ringback stop safely on accept/cancel.
No production, Play, EAS OTA, database schema/function, security credential, ad placement or season2 embargo changes.
Private 30-second video comments preserve account/Cluster authorization; GIF/Genesis photo-import controls are untouched.
acceptanceChecks: Require exact-head TS, source/Node regression, Android JS Metro export, protected engineering and ads/tab navigation gates.
Before any staging OTA compare source to signed APK SHA 435e071da41c83071f545c9b209acb562863f7d2 and fail on native/config/dependency/Godot divergence.
Require exact remote channel map, 2.0.5 runtime, staging package, Android-only OTA ID/group/source receipt with production branch unchanged; no staging announcement.
Verify actual 2.0.5 Android Godot boot/exit, AdMob and two-device incoming/outgoing/ringtone/weak network/busy/decline/no-answer behavior; until then RC HOLD.
Reconcile backend-dependent/unresolved feature branches independently, don't enable missing RPCs or experimental ranked rewards.
New comment picker/playback and signed URL retry must pass integrated Android video tests; live phone verification not yet performed.
